verses.pali: “Sasaṅkhārā, bhikkhave, uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, no asaṅkhārā.
verses.english: “Bad, unskillful qualities, mendicants, arise with conditions, not without conditions.

verses.pali: Tesaṁyeva saṅkhārānaṁ pahānā evaṁ te pāpakā akusalā dhammā na hontī”ti.
verses.english: By giving up those conditions, those bad, unskillful qualities do not occur.”
